messages:
Sam J: Hey people-ops — I need to open a confidential accommodation request. Newborn at home, daycare logistics are rough, and I was also flagged in my 1:1 for a couple of missed deliverables. I'm asking for a 6-week temporary hybrid schedule + no late meetings after 15:00. Also would like a short performance support/check-in plan so expectations are clear. Prefer this stays confidential between me, Riley, and Aisha. Thanks.

Riley (People Ops): Thanks for flagging this, Sam. We can do a short-term accommodation and a light performance check-in. Can you confirm exact dates and what you mean by 'hybrid' (which days remote vs office)? We'll need manager sign-off. I'll loop in Maya from HR to confirm process.

Aisha (Manager): Sam — happy to support. Proposed pattern: Thu in-office, Mon/Wed remote, flexible Friday. Also happy to shift recurring meetings. Can we sketch 3 measurable checkpoints for the 6 weeks (e.g., PR turnaround, oncall response, sprint completion) and a weekly 30-min sync? I can own the weekly check-ins.

Sam J: Thanks Aisha. Proposal: Mon/Wed remote, Thu in-office, Fri remote as needed. Checkpoints: 1) No critical PRs open >5 business days; 2) Oncall response <30m when scheduled; 3) Sprint tasks 80% completed or blockers documented. Weekly 30-min sync works. Prefer start Monday 2026-04-06 for six weeks.

Riley (People Ops): Copying Maya. @Maya can you confirm next steps? Sam, we typically need a short accommodation note (no medical details required unless you want to provide them) and manager confirmation of goals. We'll treat this as confidential. Maya?

Maya (HR): Hi Sam, Riley — we can treat this as a temporary accommodation without medical documentation for the short term. Process: 1) Employee confirms dates/preferences in writing (Sam has) 2) Manager confirms operational goals (Aisha has) 3) People Ops drafts an accommodation notice with start/end date and scope for signatures. We'll also append a performance-support addendum to clarify checkpoints and review cadence. All docs remain confidential in HR/People Ops.

Sam J: :relieved: I confirm 2026-04-06 to 2026-05-17, Mon/Wed remote, Thu in-office, and blocking meetings after 15:00. I consent to Aisha seeing the accommodation terms so she can track checkpoints. Thank you.

Aisha (Manager): Confirmed. I'll adjust recurring meetings and send a private calendar update. I'll track the three checkpoints and provide weekly notes to HR. Sam, please ping me if workload spikes and you need temporary backfill for oncall or a PR pairing session.

Riley (People Ops): I'll draft the accommodation notice today and share in a private thread for signatures. If either of you foresee needing oncall coverage or task reallocation, flag it here and we'll coordinate temporary swaps. :thumbsup:

Sam J: Might need a Tuesday oncall swap in week 2 — I'll check with the team and post here if I need help. Really appreciate everyone's help on this.
